items.title: Authorizing the Director of Transportation to execute Contract No. SFMTA-2024-06 with the San Francisco Bicycle Coalition Education Fund for the amount of $1,494,736 over a five-year term to provide bicycle education classes, scooter education classes, and outreach services.
items.text: Authorizing the Director of Transportation to execute Contract No. SFMTA-2024-06 with the San Francisco Bicycle Coalition Education Fund for the amount of $1,494,736 over a five-year term to provide bicycle education classes, scooter education classes, and outreach services. items.decision: ADOPTED — 7 ayes (on motion to amend the resolution to clarify the contract term of an initial term of three years, with two options to renew the agree) (Resolution 240507-048)
